title: Normalize v0.3: promote ok/source/context to top-level
body: Plan-33 example shows ok/source/context as top-level fields. Current normalizer preserves unknowns under attrs and adds attrs.source; ok/context remain under attrs/meta to avoid surface churn. Consider promoting these to top-level in V03Event to match the plan example and improve analyst ergonomics, while keeping backward compatibility. Acceptance: add optional top-level ok (exit_code==0), source (plugin.command), and context object; tests updated; docs aligned.
